hard_stops: Any mounted identity mismatch or unresolved recipe component.
Any Gold, exposed holdout, retention sentinel, or final audit contamination of training labels.
Any final audit access before final model selection.
Any new GPU optimizer work without a qualifying Director directive.
Any cumulative actual new GPU-training time above 28,800 seconds.
Any attempt to call the reconstructed adapter the recovered Original Foundation-V2 adapter.
phase_0_cpu_preparation: Freeze the V1 closure without modifying frozen V1 artifacts.
Freeze and independently verify the full mounted base, tokenizer, Novel V1.1 dataset, replay shard, schedule, environment, and source-commit identities.
Freeze the preregistered reconstruction equivalence gate and the 7,200-second reconstruction reservation.
Require Director CONTINUE or CONTINUE_WITH_WARNING with scientific_training_authorized true.

phase_1_reconstruction.entry_condition: Director authorization plus passed prelaunch identity and budget reservation checks.
phase_1_reconstruction.stop_or_escalate: At the 7,200-second reservation stop optimizer work, checkpoint/save/finalize, and escalate if the frozen 2M-token recipe is incomplete.

phase_2_equivalence.only_EQUIVALENCE_CONFIRMED_allows: Targeted capability repair V1R from the newly hashed reconstructed adapter.
phase_2_equivalence.partial_or_failed: Preserve all candidate checkpoints, prediction hashes, metrics, and receipts; escalate to Director; do not start targeted repair.

phase_3_targeted_repair_v1r.baseline: The selected RECONSTRUCTED_FOUNDATION_V2_V1 checkpoint, explicitly distinct from Original Foundation-V2.
phase_3_targeted_repair_v1r.budget: The remaining portion of the single 28,800-second ledger only. Replay remains nonzero.
phase_3_targeted_repair_v1r.data_and_evaluation: Reuse prior V1 targeted data/evaluation materials only after a new stage-compatibility, split-isolation, provenance, no-Gold, and sealed-final-audit check records their hashes. The reconstruction model cannot inherit any original-adapter claim.
phase_3_targeted_repair_v1r.entry_condition: EQUIVALENCE_CONFIRMED and remaining cumulative budget after reconstruction.
phase_3_targeted_repair_v1r.gates: Retain targeted DEV, composition DEV, paired retention, prerequisite-aware sampling, adaptive curriculum, and round acceptance/rejection gates; no full diagnostic at every checkpoint.

review_cadence: Director escalation after EQUIVALENCE_PARTIAL or EQUIVALENCE_FAILED
Director review before any V1R targeted repair authorization
then every two accepted targeted rounds or approximately one million new tokens

runtime_assets.monitoring: small receipt/status JSON only via LOW_FREQUENCY_RECONCILIATION

starting_condition.historical_reference: Original Foundation-V2 is a frozen historical reference whose adapter bytes are unrecoverable.
starting_condition.new_condition: RECONSTRUCTED_FOUNDATION_V2_V1 is a new LoRA adapter trained only from RECONSTRUCTED_V2_RECIPE_FREEZE.json after all mounted-input hashes pass.
